title: Salawat
blurb: Sending blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ

items.title: Salat al-Ibrahimiyyah
items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ، وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
items.tr: Allahumma salli ʿala Muhammadin wa ʿala ali Muhammad, kama sallayta ʿala Ibrahima wa ʿala ali Ibrahim, innaka Hamidun Majid.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You sent blessings upon Ibrahim and upon the family of Ibrahim. Indeed You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.
items.benefits: The salawat the Companions were taught when they asked how to send blessings upon him ﷺ. Recited in the final sitting of every prayer.

items.title: The blessing joined to it
items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ، وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
items.tr: Allahumma barik ʿala Muhammadin wa ʿala ali Muhammad, kama barakta ʿala Ibrahima wa ʿala ali Ibrahim, innaka Hamidun Majid.
items.en: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim. Indeed You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.

items.title: Salawat on his household
items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
items.tr: Allahumma salli ʿala Muhammadin wa ʿala azwajihi wa dhurriyyatih, kama sallayta ʿala ali Ibrahim; wa barik ʿala Muhammadin wa ʿala azwajihi wa dhurriyyatih, kama barakta ʿala ali Ibrahim, innaka Hamidun Majid.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and upon his wives and his offspring, as You sent blessings upon the family of Ibrahim; and bless Muhammad and his wives and his offspring, as You blessed the family of Ibrahim. Indeed You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.

items.title: After the adhan
items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ وَالصَّلاَةِ الْقَائِمَةِ آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ
items.tr: Allahumma Rabba hadhihi-d-daʿwatit-tammah, was-salatil-qa’imah, ati Muhammadanil-wasilata wal-fadilah, wabʿathhu maqaman mahmudanilladhi waʿadtah.
items.en: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and the prayer about to be established, grant Muhammad the means and the excellence, and raise him to the praised station You have promised him.
items.benefits: Said on hearing the adhan. The narration attaches intercession on the Day of Rising to whoever says it.

items.title: Ten in return for one
items.ar: مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَىَّ صَلاَةً صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ بِهَا عَشْرًا
items.tr: Man salla ʿalayya salatan sallallahu ʿalayhi biha ʿashra.
items.en: Whoever sends blessings upon me once, Allah sends blessings upon him ten times over.
items.notes: This is the Prophet’s ﷺ own statement about salawat, not a formula to recite.
